Overview

Feira de Santana is a city in BA with a population of 624,783. Bahia’s second-largest city and a major commercial hub, known for its large open-air market and central role in regional trade. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
